# laravelforge_server_php_cli_version (Resource)

Manages the default CLI PHP version of a Laravel Forge server (singleton). Selects which installed PHP version the `php` CLI points to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version the CLI should point to. One of `5.6`, `7.0`, `7.1`, `7.2`, `7.3`, `7.4`, `8.0`, `8.1`, `8.2`, `8.3`, `8.4`, `8.5`.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose CLI PHP version is managed.

### Read-Only

- `binary_name` (String) Name of the PHP binary (e.g. `php82`).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `status` (String) Installation status of the PHP version.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (String) Active CLI PHP version reported by Forge.
